description: This Java source file defines an EncounterRoleValidator class responsible for validating EncounterRole objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. It extends a base validator, performs validation checks on fields like name, description, and retireReason, and ensures no duplicate EncounterRole names exist.

classes.name: EncounterRoleValidator
classes.description: A validator class for the EncounterRole model, extending RequireNameValidator, that ensures the EncounterRole objects meet specific validation criteria, including checking for duplicate names and field length constraints.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on an EncounterRole object, checking for duplicate names, null or improper field lengths, and using superclass validation for required fields.
